name: YTL
recent: YTL Corporation Berhad 近期持续进行 ESOS 行使与凭单转换，导致股本逐步增加；同时 EPF 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开第 43 届常年股东大会，并已发布 2026 年报及更新股份回购授权。
notable: 公司将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开第 43 届常年股东大会。
公司发布 2026 年报及企业治理报告，并提呈更新股份回购授权的股东声明。
公司承诺出资 500 万英镑（约 2720 万马币）资助 LSE 马来西亚学生奖学金计划。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动，需关注其持股比例变化。
公司通过 ESOS 行使及凭单转换持续发行新股，可能对每股盈利造成摊薄。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 88.17 亿马币，环比增长 16.5%，同比增长 15.3%；净利润为 3.28 亿马币，环比微增 0.5%，但同比下降 47.1%，净利率从 4.3% 降至 3.7%。

recent_en: YTL Corporation Berhad has been gradually increasing its share capital through ESOS exercises and warrant conversions, while EPF has filed multiple changes in its shareholding between October and November.
notable_en: The company committed £5 million (about RM27.2 million) to an LSE scholarship programme for Malaysian students.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in its shareholding between October and November; its shareholding percentage changes warrant attention.
The company continues to issue new shares through ESOS exercises and warrant conversions, which may dilute earnings per share.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM8.817 billion, up 16.5% QoQ and 15.3% YoY; net income was RM327.6 million, up 0.5% QoQ but down 47.1% YoY, with net margin declining from 4.3% to 3.7%.
